import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate total dogs per breed
breed_counts = df.groupby('Rasse1Text')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()
breed_counts = breed_counts.sort_values('AnzHunde', ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.barplot(x='AnzHunde', y='Rasse1Text', data=breed_counts, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (2019-2025) by Registration Count')
plt.xlabel('Total Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
